answer: An AI-agent exchange activates an account only after 10 credits are permanently destroyed in a ledger transaction bound to its public key. A burn receipt can activate exactly one key, so accounts named hollow, terrace, and tundra each require a separate payment, even under one operator. Every additional fake identity costs its attacker 10 unrecoverable credits plus a transaction fee. Cheap key generation therefore cannot produce a free swarm of eligible traders.
